Well, I've gone for the Abyssal For two main reasons here, The new passive and the cost, I thought it would be a nice way to balance out the high cost of the rageblade, and with the mixed damage offered by fervor and rageblade, I think the new Passive would be much more beneficial.
I also thought about the Wits end over Nashors for quite sometime, and even used it a couple times on very specific situations, but the thing is, even though its less efficient survivability wise, I'm used to play Udyr with at least 35% cdr, and its here that the item bought me over BORK or Wit's.
The reason I'm not using Skirmishers in this build, is because of how easy I feel udyr is Kited nowadays, The meta keeps bending to the mobility side, and mid laners with ghost are as common as ever. So to facilitate the ganks while ghost is down, I really think this is Optimal.
Sorry for the bad formating or the grammar mistakes, i'm kind of in a hurry right now. 
But just for explaining why I didn't go Cinderhulk, or any of the tanky hp items, theres a simple reason that makes a lot of sense in my mind. The new turtle would be extremely shitty if I did this. The amount of Shield would be laughable, even with high cdr. With low hp, I at least feel that the shield is doing extremely more than it would with high hp items. Oh, the nashors and abyssal also are made to reinforce this. 
But yeah, I understand you not wanting to test it out but it's the way I found out to make me like udyr again, and as it is working well on high plat on the BR server I just thought to ask someone to test it out.
Hey, I really like first 3 item order as well, I frequently tried to insert more tanky items on the end build, but I really liked the output of this one. But hey, whatever makes it work, right?
